name: Cancel a crawl job.
description: Cancel a crawl job. Cancels an ongoing crawl job by setting its status to cancelled and stopping all queued URLs. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/crawl/{job_id}

name: Close browser session.
description: Close browser session. Closes an existing browser session. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}

name: Get crawl result.
description: Get crawl result. Returns the result of a crawl job. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/crawl/{job_id}
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/crawl/{job_id}
Returns the result of a crawl job.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; job_id (path) — Crawl job ID.
Optional: cacheTTL (query) — Cache TTL default is 5s. Set to 0 to disable.; status (query) — Filter by URL status.; cursor (query) — Cursor for pagination.; limit (query) — Limit for pagination.

name: Connect to browser session.
description: Connect to browser session. Establishes a WebSocket connection to an existing browser session. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}
Establishes a WebSocket connection to an existing browser session.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; session_id (path) — Browser session ID to connect to.
Optional: keep_alive (query) — Keep-alive time in ms (only valid when acquiring new session).; lab (query) — Use experimental browser.; recording (query); cf-brapi-guardrails (header) — Optional base64url-encoded JSON connection guardrails (mode)

name: Acquire and connect to browser session.
description: Acquire and connect to browser session. Acquires and establishes a WebSocket connection to a browser session. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser
Acquires and establishes a WebSocket connection to a browser session. Session guardrails may be supplied in the `cf-brapi-guardrails` header as base64url-encoded JSON of the same `guardrails` object the POST body accepts (for example `{"allowedDomains":["*.example.com"]}`).
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.
Optional: keep_alive (query) — Keep-alive time in ms (only valid when acquiring new session).; lab (query) — Use experimental browser.; recording (query); cf-brapi-guardrails (header) — Optional base64url-encoded JSON session guardrails (allowedDomains and allowedDomainSets)

name: List targets.
description: List targets. Returns a list of all debuggable targets including tabs, pages, service workers, and other browser contexts. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/json
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/json
Returns a list of all debuggable targets including tabs, pages, service workers, and other browser contexts.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; session_id (path) — Browser session ID.
Optional: liveViewUrlExpiresInMs (query) — How long the live view URLs remain valid, in milliseconds (max 60 minutes)

name: Activate a browser target.
description: Activate a browser target. Activates (brings to front) a specific browser target by its ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/json/activate/{target_id}

name: Close a browser target.
description: Close a browser target. Closes a specific browser target (tab, page, etc.) by its ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/json/close/{target_id}

name: List targets.
description: List targets. Returns a list of all debuggable targets including tabs, pages, service workers, and other browser contexts. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/json/list
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/json/list
Returns a list of all debuggable targets including tabs, pages, service workers, and other browser contexts.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; session_id (path) — Browser session ID.
Optional: liveViewUrlExpiresInMs (query) — How long the live view URLs remain valid, in milliseconds (max 60 minutes)

name: Get Chrome DevTools Protocol schema.
description: Get Chrome DevTools Protocol schema. Returns the complete Chrome DevTools Protocol schema including all domains, commands, events, and types. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/json/protocol
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/json/protocol
Returns the complete Chrome DevTools Protocol schema including all domains, commands, events, and types. This schema describes the entire CDP API surface.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; session_id (path) — Browser session ID.

name: Get a target by ID.
description: Get a target by ID. Returns the debuggable target with the given ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/json/list/{target_id}

name: Get browser version metadata.
description: Get browser version metadata. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/json/version
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/json/version
Get browser version metadata.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; session_id (path) — Browser session ID.

name: Connect to a specific Chrome DevTools page.
description: Connect to a specific Chrome DevTools page. Establishes a WebSocket connection to a specific Chrome DevTools target or page. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/page/{target_id}
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/page/{target_id}
Establishes a WebSocket connection to a specific Chrome DevTools target or page.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; session_id (path) — Browser session ID.; target_id (path) — Target ID, e.g. page ID.
Optional: cf-brapi-guardrails (header) — Optional base64url-encoded JSON connection guardrails (mode)

name: Get session details.
description: Get session details. Get details for a specific browser session. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/session/{session_id}

name: List sessions.
description: List sessions. List active browser sessions. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/session
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/session
List active browser sessions.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.
Optional: limit (query); offset (query)

name: Get accessibility tree page
description: Get accessibility tree page Returns the page's accessibility tree. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/accessibilityTree
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/accessibilityTree
Returns the page's accessibility tree. Use `interestingOnly` to only return semantically meaningful nodes; use `root` to scope the tree to a CSS-selector-anchored subtree. Control page loading with `gotoOptions` and `waitFor*` options.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; body (body)
Optional: cacheTTL (query) — Cache TTL default is 5s. Set to 0 to disable.

name: Get HTML content.
description: Get HTML content. Fetches rendered HTML content from provided URL or HTML. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/content
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/content
Fetches rendered HTML content from provided URL or HTML. Check available options like `gotoOptions` and `waitFor*` to control page load behaviour.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; body (body)
Optional: cacheTTL (query) — Cache TTL default is 5s. Set to 0 to disable.

name: Crawl websites.
description: Crawl websites. Starts a crawl job for the provided URL and its children. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/crawl
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/crawl
Starts a crawl job for the provided URL and its children. Check available options like `gotoOptions` and `waitFor*` to control page load behaviour.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; body (body)
Optional: cacheTTL (query) — Cache TTL default is 5s. Set to 0 to disable.

name: Get a browser session ID.
description: Get a browser session ID. Acquires a browser and returns its session ID and websocket URL. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser
Acquires a browser and returns its session ID and websocket URL. Optionally accepts a JSON body with session guardrails to restrict outbound HTTP/S traffic.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.
Optional: keep_alive (query) — Keep-alive time in milliseconds.; lab (query) — Use experimental browser.; targets (query) — Include browser targets in response.; liveViewUrlExpiresInMs (query) — How long the live view URL remains valid, in milliseconds (max 60 minutes). Only used when targets is true.; recording (query); body (body)

name: Mint live view URLs for a browser session
description: Mint live view URLs for a browser session Generates time-limited URLs to view a remote browser session. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/live_view
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/live_view
Generates time-limited URLs to view a remote browser session. Set `guardrails: { mode: 'readonly' }` to create a view-only link.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; session_id (path) — Browser session ID
Optional: body (body)

name: Get json.
description: Get json. Gets json from a webpage from a provided URL or HTML. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/json
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/json
Gets json from a webpage from a provided URL or HTML. Pass `prompt` or `schema` in the body. Control page loading with `gotoOptions` and `waitFor*` options.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; body (body)
Optional: cacheTTL (query) — Cache TTL default is 5s. Set to 0 to disable.

name: Get Links.

POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/links

name: Open a new browser tab.
description: Open a new browser tab. Opens a new tab in the browser. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/json/new
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/devtools/browser/{session_id}/json/new
